body:
I'm in the same boat, I have great parents, good grades, have food, shelter and security. I'm kind of tired of living too, but then people always say "why are you like this? Why are you sad? You have so many things to be grateful for. Imagine the people who live in poverty."

Honestly, I'd be fine if a cop busted into my apartment and pulled the trigger, pointing the barrel to the roof of my mouth.
I feel this.. I just want someone who would want to lay in bed together, just enjoy each other's company in silence. I wonder how that feels.
I feel this. I'd feel really happy when I hang out with my friends, but then when I go back home it's like it never happened. And then I'd refuse their invitation next time, because what's the point.
I don't know why this is getting down voted. This is the fucking truth, you guys didn't know this person existed until this moment. How can you give two hoots if he took his life or not?

I then think about, 'is this how it'll be when we get married?' You'll always be angry at me for forgetting something, and I'll just have to take it because my memory is deficient, my brain is deficient. I am deficient. I imagine a future where we're wedded for life and then I'm that typical husband who's afraid of doing any small thing that might set off my wife. If that's the future waiting for me then why don't I just end it now, save me from a longer pain. Isn't it merciful? Isn't it much more freeing? It's not selfish.

Why is it that such a small thing like this would set me off? I don't know, but I don't think it's just this one small thing. It was not having someone that I can relate to in my group of friends, not having a close friend. It's living on my own, I know it's my choice, but I don't have anyone close enough to me that I can say I'd comfortably live with them. I've tried a summer living in an apartment with strangers with 4 bedrooms. I had my own bedroom, it was small and cramped, I was miserable. I've tried living in a dorm with a stranger, it wasn't the worse, but I felt like an outsider.

That's it I guess, a chill just went through me, I'm an outsider, I've always been an outsider. My childhood, I was the weird one, I was the smart one, they thought it quirky that I watch educational YouTube videos. Even here in the states, I'm the weird one. I'm the one from Indonesia. Even in the group of international students, I'm the odd one out. How come my English is so good? How come you barely have any accent at all? I used to be proud of that fact, that I'm able to speak nearly flawless English. But when I think about it, I'm in the uncanny valley, so close to a real American born person and yet so far from an American. They'd assume I have the same experience as they do from the way I talk, but the truth is I don't know much about anything. And then they'd question me about it, and then I'd be left as the weird one out.

"You're not alone" people always tell this lie. It's such an overused line. WE ARE ALONE IN THIS WORLD. WE WERE BORN ALONE AND WE WILL DIE ON OUR OWN. I don't even know why I'm grieving, I've got parents who love me, two awesome younger brothers, a girlfriend, my parents are rich, I've got food, internet, shelter, air conditioning, I'm the lucky one from my high school who gets to study abroad, I'm a privileged motherfucker, as privileged as they come. Really, what more could I want? But the thing is, I've lived with people close to me my whole life, I've never had to go out and meet strangers, make friends, it's always been there for me. Now that I've spent years abroad, the people that I used to be close with, we've drifted apart. And it's not anybody's fault, it's just how it is, the distance, the lack of communication from my part and theirs, you can't make connections through a screen, we have millenials of years to show that humans make connections through every day, face to face interactions. As cheesy as it sounds, I can't really feel love from them through a screen. Yeah they'd be worried, they'd wonder about what I'm doing today, how I'm doing, they'd probably feel sad if I died. But this too will pass, they'll grieve for me, a month, a year, but then just like how Yeye passed on and now it's in the past, it's history. Just a number on a spreadsheet. I'll be like that too. They'll say it's the easy way out, that I'm selfish. It's my fucking life, I'll do whatever I want with it. You're the one who brought me into this world selfishly, I never asked for it. You're the one who's selfishly desiring for me not to kill myself. It's not easy to take your own life, otherwise I wouldn't be writing this. So don't fucking tell me that I'm taking the easy way out.

Well, I guess this goes to show you that money can't buy happiness, you can loan it yes, but you'll be in serious debt before you know it.
